text_en: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for all who have not seen me face to face.
text_cn: 我实愿意你们知道：我为你们和那些在劳狄刻雅以及所有未曾亲眼看见过我的人，作如何的奋斗，

text_en: I want their hearts to be encouraged and united in love, so that they may have all the riches of assured understanding and have the knowledge of God’s mystery, that is, Christ himself,
text_cn: 为使他们的心受到鼓励，使他们在爱内互相连结，充分地得到真知灼见，能认识天主的奥秘──基督，

text_en: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
text_cn: 因为在他内蕴藏着智慧和知识的一切宝藏。

text_en: I am saying this so that no one may deceive you with plausible arguments.
text_cn: 我说这话，免得有人以花言巧语欺骗你们。

text_en: For though I am absent in body, yet I am with you in spirit, and I rejoice to see your morale and the firmness of your faith in Christ.
text_cn: 我肉身虽然不在你们那里，但心灵却与你们同在，高兴见到你们生活的秩序，和你们对基督的坚定信仰。

text_en: As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, continue to live your lives in him,
text_cn: 你们既然接受了基督耶稣为主，就该在他内行动生活，

text_en: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, just as you were taught, abounding in thanksgiving.
text_cn: 在他内生根修建，坚定于你们所学得的信德，满怀感恩之情。

text_en: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deceit, according to human tradition, according to the elemental spirits of the universe, and not according to Christ.
text_cn: 你们要小心，免得有人以哲学，以虚伪的妄言，按照人的传授，依据世俗的原理，而不是依据基督，把你们勾引了去。

text_en: For in him the whole fullness of deity dwells bodily,
text_cn: 因为是在基督内，真实地住有整个圆满的天主性，你们也是在他内得到丰满。

text_en: and you have come to fullness in him, who is the head of every ruler and authority.
text_cn: 他是一切率领者和掌权者的元首，

text_en: In him also you were circumcised with a spiritual circumcision, by putting off the body of the flesh in the circumcision of Christ;
text_cn: 你们也是在他内受了割损，但不是人手所行的割损，而是基督的割损，在乎脱去肉欲之身。

text_en: when you were buried with him in baptism, you were also raised with him through faith in the power of God, who raised him from the dead.
text_cn: 你们既因圣洗与他一同埋葬了，也就因圣洗，借着信德，即信使他由死者中复活的天主的能力，与他一同复活了。

text_en: And when you were dead in trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive together with him, when he forgave us all our trespasses,
text_cn: 你们从前因了你们的过犯和未受割损的肉身，原是死的；但天主却使你们与基督一同生活，赦免了我们的一切过犯：

text_en: erasing the record that stood against us with its legal demands. He set this aside, nailing it to the cross.
text_cn: 涂抹了那相反我们，告发我们对诫命负债的债券，把它从中除去，将它钉在十字架上；

text_en: He disarmed the rulers and authorities and made a public example of them, triumphing over them in it.
text_cn: 解除了率领者和掌权者的武装，把他们公然示众，仗赖十字架，带着他们举行凯旋的仪式。

text_en: Therefore do not let anyone condemn you in matters of food and drink or of observing festivals, new moons, or sabbaths.
text_cn: 为此，不要让任何人在饮食上，或在节期或月朔或安息日等事上，对你们有所规定。

text_en: These are only a shadow of what is to come, but the substance belongs to Christ.
text_cn: 这一切原是未来事物的阴影，至于实体乃是基督。

text_en: Do not let anyone disqualify you, insisting on self-abasement and worship of angels, dwelling on visions, puffed up without cause by a human way of thinking,
text_cn: 不可让那甘愿自卑而敬拜天使的人，夺去你们的奖品，这种人只探究所见的幻象，因自己的血肉之见，妄自尊大，

text_en: and not holding fast to the head, from whom the whole body, nourished and held together by its ligaments and sinews, grows with a growth that is from God.
text_cn: 而不与头相连接；其实由于头，全身才能赖关节和脉络获得滋养而互相连结，借天主所赐的生长力而生长。

text_en: If with Christ you died to the elemental spirits of the universe, why do you live as if you still belonged to the world? Why do you submit to regulations,
text_cn: 既然你们与基督已同死于世俗的原理，为什么还如生活在世俗中一样，受人指点：

text_en: “Do not handle, Do not taste, Do not touch”?
text_cn: “不可拿，不可尝，不可摸，”

text_en: All these regulations refer to things that perish with use; they are simply human commands and teachings.
text_cn: 拘泥于人的规定和教训呢？──其实这一切，一经使用，便败坏了。

text_en: These have indeed an appearance of wisdom in promoting self-imposed piety, humility, and severe treatment of the body, but they are of no value in checking self-indulgence.
text_cn: 这些教规既基于随从私意的敬礼、谦卑和苦身克己，徒有智慧之名，并没有什么价值，只为满足肉欲而已。
